name: Sovereign Resident Source Refresh
purpose: Perform the already-proven local-only sovereign WorkerCoordinator/runtime source refresh when the governed state transition establishing a callable runtime connection resolves refreshable=true for that invocation, preserving mutable runtime state and emitting authentic refresh or boundary evidence without creating an always-on runtime source or a new runtime owner.
trigger: the governed connection-establishment transition evaluates callable=true and refreshable=true for the invocation
scope: one invocation-bound already-local canonical source root and one invocation-bound sovereign runtime connection

state_transition_variables.callable: whether the runtime connection may be instantiated/called for this transition
state_transition_variables.refreshable: whether source refresh is required/permitted as part of establishing this invocation's runtime connection

reuse_instructions: Do not model refresh as unconditional or conditional on persistent runtime-source freshness. callable and refreshable are invocation-bound variables of the governed state transition that establishes the runtime connection. If callable=false, this reusable task does not establish a callable runtime. If callable=true and refreshable=true, perform the local source refresh and retain authentic evidence. If callable=true and refreshable=false, do not invent a refresh requirement. Interlock/InTr remains the governed transition authority. Do not create another source refresher, runtime owner, scheduler, credential route, or source transport.
